# Pages F74_A0000443 / F74_A0000444. Sequence ids and segmentation = T2 (no split/merge). 444-07 onward: clear text (closing, date, subscription, endorsement) - no cipher run, no 444-07-x sequence.

# Tokens (T2 conventions): Fxx = CATALOGUE_F shape; '?' = remaining doubt. F23 = o then bar right; F32 = bar then o; F08 = o/6 under flat bar (sigma-like); F24 = loop on bar; F39 = b/6 with crossbar (also the frequent 5-bodied sign with crossed ascender); F27 = ʒ without ascender; F09 = a/alpha/lambda-like loop with back stroke.
# ÷ family: F13 = bar with dot above and below; F01 = bar + dot below only; F36 = bar + dot above only.

# X:5 = long-s / 5-like hooked stroke; X:5^o = same with superscript small o; X:5t = same with extra crossbar; X:9 = g/9 with curved tail (F25 = q, straight stem); X:B = capital-B-like; X:L = L/right-angle; X:L^g = L with small g/9 superscript

# X:2 = 2-like; X:2^c = 2 with small c above; X:A = A-like pointed loop; X:F = capital-F-like; X:N = N-like; X:psi = psi-like; X:Vbar = v with bar over; X:bar = isolated horizontal bar; X:r = r-like; X:w = w-like; X:brace = brace-like stroke; X:loop = 6 with looped ascender
# F24^c = F24 with small c above. K:HH = H/#-like double/triple-stem group; K:⊙ = circled dot; K:theta = circle with inner bar; K:dot = heavy isolated dot used as sign. Punctuation dots ignored.
